simple.meaning: זָדוֹן (zâdôwn) is a Hebrew object word meaning “arrogance.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Deuteronomy 17:12. The surrounding context includes family, priesthood, prophetic witness, wilderness, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to זָדוֹן (H2087) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: זָדוֹן (zâdôwn) / H2087 is traced through Deuteronomy 17:12, Deuteronomy 18:22, 1 Samuel 17:28, Proverbs 11:2 with generated occurrence evidence.

firstOccurrence.englishText: The man who does presumptuously in not listening to the priest who stands to minister there before Yahweh your God, or to the judge, even that man shall die. You shall put away the evil from Israel.

timeline.evidenceText: The man who does presumptuously in not listening to the priest who stands to minister there before Yahweh your God, or to the judge, even that man shall die. You shall put away the evil from Israel.

When a prophet speaks in Yahweh’s name, if the thing doesn’t follow, nor happen, that is the thing which Yahweh has not spoken. The prophet has spoken it presumptuously. You shall not be afraid of him.

Eliab his oldest brother heard when he spoke to the men; and Eliab’s anger burned against David, and he said, “Why have you come down? With whom have you left those few sheep in the wilderness? I know your pride, and the naughtiness of your heart; for you have come down that you might see the battle.”
When pride comes, then comes shame,
The proud and arrogant man—“Scoffer” is his name—
“Behold, I am against you, you proud one,” says the Lord, Yahweh of Armies;
The proud one will stumble and fall,
“ ‘Behold, the day! Behold, it comes! Your doom has gone out. The rod has blossomed. Pride has budded.
The pride of your heart has deceived you, you who dwell in the clefts of the rock, whose habitation is high, who says in his heart, ‘Who will bring me down to the ground?’

definitions.full: H2087. zadon זָדוֺן noun masculine Prov 11:2 insolence, presumptuousness (on formation compare Lag BN 204, Anm .), absolute ׳ז Deut 17:12 7 t.; construct זְדוֺן Jer 49:16 ; Obadiah 3; suffix זְדֹנְךָ 1Sam 17:28 ; — 1 insolence, presumption toward men; affirmed of David by Eliab 1Sam 17:28 (|| לְבָבֶ֑ךָ רֹעַ ); usually 2 of presumptuous godlessness (compare זֵד זוּד, ), exhibited in disobedience to priest or judge Deut 17:12 ; in false prediction 18:22 ; in General Prov 11:2 (opposed to צְנוּעִים ), 13:10 ; ז ׳עֶבְרַת 21:24 (compare זֵד ); ׳ז לִבֶּ֑ךָ ) Jer 49:16 ( = Obadiah 3) presumption of thine heart ; of Babylon personified under figure of ׳ז 50:31-32 , dubious is הַזּ ׳מָּרַח Ezek 7:10 insolence hath blossomed (preceded by הַמַּטֶּה צָץ ) i.e. either of Israel as demanding punishment, or of Babylon as instrument of punishment.
